timing.limits: Exclusive scheduler CPUs do not isolate memory bandwidth, package power, interrupts, kernel activity or shared caches. Nested governors have a separate restoration audit.
timing.draw_scope: Draw includes gui.prepareLocalPresentation scene/snapshot capture every frame, command recording and intermediate flushes. Simulation state is fixed/paused where configured; one extracted scene is not reused throughout. Final raster work may occur during presentation. Complete frame ratios are required alongside draw ratios.
timing.live_scope: Live duration probes have differing work; no fixed-work ratio inferred.
